org.name: Blackline Climbing
org.tagline: Bouldering gym on the north side
org.mission: Blackline is a bouldering gym for people who like hard problems and don't need a lecture. 5,000 square feet of wall, reset every week, a training board, and coffee that isn't an afterthought. Day passes, punch cards and monthly memberships; no contracts.
org.about:
We opened in 2023 in the old print shop on Valmont. Two of us set, one of us runs the front, and a rotating cast of friends keeps the place from falling apart.

The gym is small on purpose. You will recognise people. Problems get reset on Mondays, the board is open whenever we are, and youth club runs on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons.

copy.audience: Climbers in north Boulder from first-timers to V10, and parents looking for a youth club that takes the sport seriously.
